# TermFetch Studio

> An open-source Rust terminal UI for customizing Fastfetch themes, module layouts, semantic colors and ASCII or image logos. The interactive browser demo uses sample system data and can export Fastfetch JSONC.

This is an optional navigation summary. It does not grant access to private data or guarantee indexing, rankings or citations.

## Product and catalogs

- [Overview and interactive studio](https://termfetch-studio.sinansarikaya.dev/): Product features and a browser demo with privacy-safe sample values.
- [Themes](https://termfetch-studio.sinansarikaya.dev/themes): The current source catalog of 30 Fastfetch palettes, including Catppuccin, Nord, Tokyo Night and Synthwave.
- [Presets](https://termfetch-studio.sinansarikaya.dev/presets): Full Info with 25 modules, Minimal, Focused, Developer, Gaming and Custom Modules.
- [Questions and answers](https://termfetch-studio.sinansarikaya.dev/faq): Fastfetch requirements, custom images, demo mode, configuration exports and platform scope.

## Installation and documentation

- [Downloads](https://termfetch-studio.sinansarikaya.dev/downloads): Verified published v2.0.0 Windows x64, universal macOS and Linux archives, DEB/RPM packages, and SHA-256 checksums. Homebrew, WinGet, Scoop and AUR publication is pending; no unverified install commands are provided.
- [Documentation](https://termfetch-studio.sinansarikaya.dev/docs): Themes, presets, modules, color behavior and browser/native boundaries.
- [Getting started](https://termfetch-studio.sinansarikaya.dev/docs/getting-started): Try the browser demo, export JSONC and use Fastfetch locally.
- [Releases](https://termfetch-studio.sinansarikaya.dev/releases): Published release history versus the current v2.1.1 source checkout. Source state is not a claim that v2.1.0 binaries are published.

## Primary project sources

- [GitHub source](https://github.com/sinansarikaya/termfetch-studio): Rust source, issues and development history.
- [Published v2.0.0 release](https://github.com/sinansarikaya/termfetch-studio/releases/tag/v2.0.0): Version-specific binaries and release notes.
- [MIT license](https://github.com/sinansarikaya/termfetch-studio/blob/main/LICENSE): Project license.

Fastfetch is a separate dependency. Actual terminal geometry and image protocol support vary by terminal. The browser preview does not inspect the visitor's hardware or write host configuration files.
